_comment: Area map for simple-dispatcher, written once by hand on 2026-10-17 at commit 0d54b97 BEFORE any import map was run, from docs/module-map.md and each module's header comment. First match wins. Frozen for this trial: no label may be changed to move a measure. 'other' is the catch-all and owns nothing.

areas.name: loop
areas.why: the poll loop and processPolledItem router (claim -> assess -> route -> execute)

areas.name: intake
areas.why: what to take and whether to admit it: queue transport, pre-flight verdicts, follow-up/abort/duplicate resolution, halt policy, subscription vocabulary

areas.name: pacing
areas.why: when a launch may begin: cold-start pacing and the launch circuit breaker

areas.name: launch
areas.why: how a session is started: executor registry, harness (engine) registry, terminal drivers

areas.name: opencode
areas.why: the opencode harness's own per-session runner and its liveness reader

areas.name: hook
areas.why: the Stop hook: protocol decision, sentinels, refusal classification

areas.name: transcript
areas.why: reading what an agent did: transcript reader, heartbeat KPIs, evidence links

areas.name: reapers
areas.why: during-work and after-work sweeps: watchdogs, stall failsafe, cleanup, clone inspector

areas.name: feedback
areas.why: talking back to Harbour: feedback POSTs, chunking, the bounded fetch, the credential broker

areas.name: state
areas.why: the IPC bus and its vocabulary: sessions.json store, phases, targets

areas.name: process
areas.why: signals SD sends and receives: signal guard, shutdown handler

areas.name: telemetry
areas.why: durable local logs and resource sampling

areas.name: e2e
areas.why: manual end-to-end smoke tooling at the repo root (not production)
